articles.headline: Rangers use a 6-run 5th inning to beat Diamondbacks 6-2, stay in AL playoff race
articles.description: — Ezequiel Duran had a two-run single and Wyatt Langford hit a solo homer during a six-run fifth inning to lead the Texas Rangers over the Arizona Diamondbacks 6-2 on Saturday night to even the three-game series.
